seal.statement: For every arrival order of the joiners of a formation, and with no timer expiring: every joiner whose node-local gates pass publishes its READY lease; the priority control-plane partitions, including the operation ledger, reach min(3, eligible) distinct voter holders; no client-facing cluster gate (serve eligibility, /readyz) opens before that spread is published; and no removal ever drops a priority partition below its voter-ready floor on READY nodes. A node's READY lease states only that the node can serve; 'formation complete' is the one published priority-partition summary owned by membership publication and is consumed where it protects (serve eligibility, /readyz, ordinary placement, the ledger quorum hold). The join operation-ledger formation barrier, the formation-release handoff (closure owner, contract, evidence, identity, publication, coordinator and the consumer read), the formation-release observer and the pre-READY priority-placement path with its carve-outs are removed from source, tests, decision tables, models, registries and documentation, not disabled.

text: SUPERSESSION RECORDS (R09), 2026-11-14, by the lead, under the owner's standing authority to supersede sealed decisions where provable stability requires it (owner, 2026-11-11). Reason for all of them: the measured formation deadlock (evidence/design/repeat-fail-analysis.md) and its cause as read from the code (evidence/design/deadlock-decision-packet.md): a joiner's READY lease waits for the startup authority, the authority waits for the priority spread, the spread needs a REPLACE whose remove-safety floor counts only voters on nodes that already hold a READY lease, and the one breaker, the formation-release handoff, can be captured only at an instant before the cohort is counted. Each entry quotes the sealed sentence this quest contradicts and says what replaces it. (1) formation-priority-spread-without-exclusive-self-move-cost (2026-07-17): 'publish an owner-authored priority-placement-ready lease ...; allow only startup-authority priority control-plane placement to target that live-transport cohort; keep ordinary placement ACTIVE-only; delay final ACTIVE until the replica_operations quorum is no longer concentrated.' Superseded: READY is not delayed and no node without a READY lease is a placement target; protection against a concentrated ledger quorum stays where it is consumed (the ledger quorum hold, serve eligibility, /readyz, the ordinary-placement gate). (2) formation-joining-ready-phase-fence: '... while an explicitly recovery-eligible reachable JOINING node can receive only priority control-plane formation placement until activation.' Superseded: no JOINING node receives placement; the first clause (a JOINING node is absent from generic serving, published-active, required-ack and remove-safety membership) stands, and the JOINING phase ends at the node's own readiness. (3) formation-release-handoff-closure v3 and v4: 'Five-node startup keeps one versioned, incarnation-bound formation-release handoff authority from the first whole-plane priority-spread-satisfied observation until every captured JOINING cohort member has published a current READY lease, so non-monotone spread-gap reopening cannot strand joiners ...' Superseded: the handoff authority is deleted; joiners cannot be stranded because READY does not depend on spread. (4) formation-release-handoff-post-reopen-capture: 'closed by the successor capture, by any revocation, and by the first incompatible or absent authority observation; it never reopens without a new completion.' Superseded: the successor admission is deleted with the closure owner. (5) formation-release-handoff-consumer-parity: '... so the operation-ledger formation barrier resolves ledger_spread_satisfied from the whole-plane authority answer instead of the raw non-monotone spread predicate' and 'a joiner cannot locally mint, promote, or rotate formation-release authority'. Superseded: the barrier and the consumer projection are deleted. (6) decision table formation-release-handoff-closure, invariant non-monotone-spread-safe: 'A compatible priority-spread reopening cannot withdraw release before every captured JOINING incarnation publishes a current READY lease.' Superseded: the table is deleted; release is not a formation concept. (7) decision table formation-cohort-spread-cure: deleted with its owner, the startup-authority placement eligibility. (8) formation-spread-progress-at-cause (2026-11-10): the cure-target exemption keyed on an active handoff, introduced because 'joining nodes stalled on NODE_READY_LEASE_INCOMPLETE without ever receiving priority spread replicas'. Superseded: the exemption is deleted; its goal holds because joiners are READY. (9) formation-barrier-spread-release-oscillation: 'An engaged operation-ledger formation barrier releases within its budget when ledger spread is achievable ...' Superseded: the barrier is deleted; the surviving property (formation completes when the spread is achievable) is restated against the rebalancer and the published summary. (10) rolling-restart-durable-rejoin-formation-barrier: 'A durable restarted node ... does not enter the cold-formation operation-ledger barrier solely because previously restarted members are temporarily pre-ready ...' Superseded as vacuous: no node enters a barrier; the rolling-restart path is re-witnessed. (11) operation-ledger-quorum-authoritative-release: its barrier paths (bypassed_insufficient_formation_cohort and the timeout) are deleted; its quorum-hold release rule is unaffected and kept. (12) model CL-044 formation-barrier-spread-cure-liveness: deleted with the mechanism it models. NOT superseded and binding: the ruling of 2026-09-28 (one semantic READY owner at the durable NODES lifecycle boundary), which this quest implements; the remove-safety committed-node authority, unchanged. FACTS FROM THE REPRODUCER that bear on the deleted mechanism and are recorded so they are not lost: without a revoke, one generation captured for cohort [j1] released j2 as well; a lone joiner's publication went epoch 2 [j1, seed] with no summary and then epoch 3 [seed], which is the READY instant the passing runs recaptured in; the revoke reason seen in every lab run (startup_authority_incompatible) was not reproduced and its cause is not known.

Stage 0b (harness only, no src change): mounted the operation workflow in the reproducer. Planner moves of the six priority partitions become operations through the real RebalanceCoordinator on every node (admission, ledger interlock, dispatch, remove safety, completion, re-plan); the double is the replica runtime at the <node>/service/replica-handler message boundary (CREATE registers a SYNCING learner row, REMOVE marks REMOVING, one step per round promotes learners and retires removals; it reads no operation, node or lease row). Planner cadence stamps (1 s check spacing, stabilization, start delay) are lapsed per round; coordinators are evaluated by their own periodic tick body. Shard registration refreshed (test:metadata:refresh, audit:shards clean). Lab job be96bee0-4526-498b-bdd5-a9a93694f438 (tv-dator) red as intended: negative control ok, stuck-state match ok, liveness and sweep not ok.

Stage 0b harness observations on main (losing order, fixpoint after 5 rounds, 62 evaluation ms, shortest armed delay 100 ms). (1) Five priority ADDs onto the first joiner (pre-READY target) complete; each of those planners then refuses its own surplus REMOVE of a seed replica with 'would drop voter-ready replicas below minimum (2/3)' (planner reason safety_blocked): the measured floor count, stated at the planner pre-check, not as a parked REPLACE. (2) The ledger REPLACE seed->j2 is created only after the ADDs finish (operation_ledger_self_move_waiting_for_idle_ledger), is dispatched by its target's workflow owner, and stays at SYNCING: no replace_remove_safety_blocked park was stated. (3) In the winning order (both joiners READY) the same REPLACE also stays at SYNCING and the four other priority ADDs are refused operation_ledger_self_move_in_flight, so the spread does not complete in the harness on any order. Production completes it on passing runs, so this is a HARNESS GAP, not a product observation: the REPLACE owner's progress past SYNCING is not driven. Not established why; candidates are the unmounted ReplicaDispatchService (coordinator-to-coordinator wakes are acknowledged and dropped) and consensus events the replica runtime double does not emit (attachReplicaConsensusEvents). Until that is closed the harness cannot answer 'the priority partitions reach three holders' for any order, and the floor probe has seen no admitted removal. (4) Also not mounted: BootstrapReadinessOwner; /readyz is read through getPriorityControlPlaneRecoveryHealthSync, the HARD dependency it consumes. (5) Two 100 ms authoritative replica_operations read-retry timers are armed from seed formation onward (replica-operation-repository-visibility-methods.js:83); their count does not grow, the reads behind them were not identified.

Stage 0c (harness only, no src change): mounted the real ReplicaDispatchService on every node (built as control-plane setup builds it; coordinator-to-coordinator REPLICA_OPERATION_DISPATCH wakes now reach the handler it registers for <node>/service/replica-dispatch); reads of a partition are answered by its leader with the leader's read authority; pings answer from the mesh. Result on main: the winning order still does NOT complete the spread. The ledger REPLACE (seed->j2) stops at SYNCING: on the wake, the owner node's ReplicaDispatchService defers its dispatch with 'Cache update not observed for replica operation <id>' (REPLICA_OPERATION_VISIBILITY_LAG, src/control-plane/replica-dispatch-service-dispatch-error-helpers.js:79-100) and arms its 250 ms operationDispatchRetryAfterMs retry, which never fires in the harness. Cause of the reported lag not established; ruled out: same-instant writes (each durable write given its own millisecond: same deferral) and follower-local reads (leader-served reads: same deferral). Losing order on main now shows: 3 priority ADDs onto j1 ACTIVE, their surplus seed REMOVEs refused 'would drop voter-ready replicas below minimum (2/3)', the other 2 priority ADDs refused operation_ledger_self_move_in_flight, the ledger REPLACE in flight and not terminal. No removal is admitted in any order, so the floor probe has still observed none. The two 100 ms replica_operations read-retry timers (replica-operation-repository-visibility-methods.js:83) were not traced to their reads.

CLARIFICATION of constraint no-timer-no-bound-no-retry and ORDER OF WORK (2026-11-14, by the lead, after the harness rounds). (1) Two kinds of timer are distinguished. A bound or timeout gives up or changes course when it expires (the barrier's 120 s formation timeout, a delivery timeout, an election timeout): the claim's liveness must hold with none of these expiring, and the harness treats one that would have to expire as no progress. A cadence re-evaluates a level condition (the planner's check spacing, the owner-membership tick, the dispatch service's retry after 'cache update not observed'): production formation legitimately advances on these, and the harness advances them as rounds, naming each cadence it stepped. The joiner-READY half of the claim is asserted with no timer of either kind; the spread half is asserted with cadences as rounds and no bound expiring. (2) The harness as it stands on main proves the joiner-READY half (stuck in 4 of 9 orders, control green) and shows, in the losing order, the floor refusing the surplus seed REMOVEs (2 of 3) and the ledger interlock refusing the remaining priority ADDs; it does not yet complete a REPLACE in any order, because the dispatch service defers on 'Cache update not observed for replica operation' and the harness delivers no committed row change to the nodes' system-table caches. That gap is owed before the spread half is claimed deterministically; it is closed after the behaviour change (stage 1b), by delivering committed row changes to each node's cache through the real cache apply at the CDC delivery boundary and stepping the dispatch retry as a named cadence. (3) Order: stage 1 (transition record, then READY on node-local gates, the startup authority without the handoff, no pre-READY placement, handoff unwired) comes now, so that the composed stack can be measured on the lab; stage 1b closes the harness gap and shows the spread half on the candidate; stage 2 is the deletion census.

(a) READY on node-local gates: signalReadyForReplicas no longer records or awaits the operation-ledger formation barrier; NodeJoiningReadySignalReadiness extends NodeJoiningOwnerConstruction; the four getPriorityPlacementFormation* methods and the OPERATION_LEDGER_FORMATION gate are removed.
